name: Ultimate Member
couldBuild: Front-end registration, login and profile editing over ordinary WordPress users, with member directories built on WP_User_Query.
stillMissing: The core is genuinely ordinary WordPress. The licence buys the extension catalogue — social login, private messaging, groups, follow — plus the moderation tooling any real community needs. Cheap to start, expensive to finish.
requirements: Front-end registration, login and password reset
Editable profiles with custom fields and privacy per field
Member directory with search and filtering
Moderation: approval queues, blocking, spam handling

alternatives.desc: Profiles, directories and restriction are free; extensions are the paid tier.
